economic_threshold_level: 8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive nights OR 10% damaged green bolls (rosette flowers observed)
damage_symptoms: Larvae bore into squares, flowers, and bolls. Attacked flowers show 'rosette flower' symptom where petals twist together. Bolls show premature drop, fiber staining, and locule burrowing.
natural_predators: Trichogramma bactrae, Bracon greeni, Chrysoperla zastrowi

economic_threshold_level: 5-10 insects/hill at tillering; 15-20 insects/hill at panicle initiation
damage_symptoms: Both nymphs and adults congregate at base of plant and suck sap. Infested plants turn yellow and dry up rapidly, resulting in circular patches of dried crop called 'hopper burn'.
natural_predators: Mirid bug (Cyrtorhinus lividipennis), Wolf spider (Lycosa pseudoannulata)

economic_threshold_level: 1-2 thrips per leaf or upward curling on 10% seedlings
damage_symptoms: Lacerate leaf surface and suck exudate. Leaves curl upwards (boat-shaped). Stunted plant growth, bronzing of leaves, reduced flower bud formation.
natural_predators: Anthocorid bugs (Orius tantillus), Green lacewing (Chrysoperla carnea)

economic_threshold_level: 1 egg mass/sq.m or 5% dead hearts at vegetative stage; 1 moth/sq.m or 2% white ears at flowering
damage_symptoms: Larvae bore into central shoot causing 'dead heart' at vegetative stage (easily pulled out) and empty, erect white chaffy panicles ('white earhead') at reproductive stage.

economic_threshold_level: 1-2 folded damaged leaves with larvae per hill
damage_symptoms: Larva folds leaf blade longitudinally and scrapes green chlorophyll from inside, creating longitudinal transparent white streaks. Severe infestation gives field a scorched white look.

economic_threshold_level: 6-8 adults or nymphs per leaf on upper/middle canopy
damage_symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck phloem sap, secrete sticky honeydew promoting black sooty mold growth on leaves and lint. Acts as principal vector for Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV).
natural_predators: Chrysoperla zastrowi, Coccinella septempunctata, Encarsia formosa

economic_threshold_level: 1-2 nymphs per leaf or downward cupping of leaf margin (Grade II injury)
damage_symptoms: Nymphs walk sideways on underside of leaves and suck sap while injecting toxic saliva. Leaf margins turn yellow, then bronze/brick red, curl downward ('hopper burn').

economic_threshold_level: 1 larva per plant or 5% damaged squares/bolls
damage_symptoms: Caterpillar feeds on squares and green bolls thrusting head inside while keeping rest of body outside. Clean circular boreholes surrounded by fecal pellets.

economic_threshold_level: 2-3 mites per leaf on top canopy
damage_symptoms: Mites suck sap from tender shoots. Leaves curl downwards (inverted boat shape / inverted cup), elongate into 'rat-tail' symptom with thickened dark green leathery texture.
natural_predators: Phytoseiid predatory mites (Amblyseius swirskii, Neoseiulus longispinosus)

economic_threshold_level: 1 egg mass or 1 skeletonized leaf patch per 10 plants
damage_symptoms: Gregarious early instar caterpillars skeletonize leaves leaving parchment-like veins. Later instars voraciously defoliate plants, cut stems, and bore into chilli pods.

economic_threshold_level: 1 larva/plant or 5% fruit damage
damage_symptoms: Larvae bore into green and ripening fruits making round holes, leading to entry of rot pathogens and fruit dropping.

economic_threshold_level: 1-2 active mines per leaf or 20-30 moths/pheromone trap/week
damage_symptoms: Larvae feed as leaf miners creating large transparent blotches (mines) in leaf mesophyll. Also bore into growing buds, stems, and fruits leaving pinhole puncture marks.

economic_threshold_level: 10-15 aphids per earhead / tiller at heading stage
damage_symptoms: Colonies of aphids suck sap from leaves, flag leaf sheath, and developing earheads, resulting in chaffy ears, shriveled grains, and reduced test weight.
natural_predators: Coccinella septempunctata, Syrphid fly larvae (Episyrphus balteatus)

economic_threshold_level: Presence of fresh soil galleries and wilting seedlings in patches
damage_symptoms: Termites feed on underground roots and stem base of germinating seedlings and mature plants, causing yellowing, drying, and lodging; affected tillers pull out easily.

economic_threshold_level: 5% damaged plants with larvae at early whorl; 10% at mid-whorl stage
damage_symptoms: Pinholes and large irregular papery windowpanes on whorl leaves. Deep feeding inside central whorl with excessive sawdust-like fecal frass accumulation. Destroys growing point ('dead heart').
natural_predators: Earwig (Euborellia annulipes), Telenomus remus, Nomuraea rileyi
citation: ICAR-IIMR & DPPQS Fall Armyworm National Campaign 2025

economic_threshold_level: 10% plants showing pinholes or dead hearts
damage_symptoms: Shot holes in leaf whorls; larvae bore into central shoots causing vegetative dead hearts. In later stages, tunnels through stalks causing stem breakage and lodging.

economic_threshold_level: 5 active larvae per plant or 20% damaged leaves
damage_symptoms: Larvae mine into tender leaflets creating blister-like mines. Later instars web leaflets together and feed within, giving the entire crop a scorched brownish appearance.

economic_threshold_level: 1-2 egg masses or 8 larvae per 10-meter row
damage_symptoms: Gregarious caterpillars migrate en masse across fields completely devastating green vegetation down to ground level within hours.

economic_threshold_level: 1 grub per square meter in soil
damage_symptoms: C-shaped fleshy white grubs chew taproots underground. Infested plants turn pale, wilt, and die in scattered patches; pull out effortlessly.

economic_threshold_level: 5-10% plants showing girdled stems
damage_symptoms: Female beetle makes two parallel ring cuts around petiole or stem and oviposits between them. Plant portion above ring withers and droops; larva tunnels downward inside pith.

economic_threshold_level: 3-4 larvae per meter row length
damage_symptoms: Larvae walk with looping motion and consume leaf lamina leaving only veins and midribs, leading to heavy defoliation during flowering and pod development.
natural_predators: Trichogramma chilonis, Bacillus thuringiensis, Nomuraea rileyi

economic_threshold_level: 1 larva per plant or 5% pod damage
damage_symptoms: Larvae bore into developing pods, consume green seeds from inside, leaving large circular bore holes and dropping frass outside.

economic_threshold_level: 5-10% infested green pods
damage_symptoms: Maggots feed inside green seeds without external symptoms until adult fly cuts an exit hole window before emerging; damaged seeds lose germination and market value.

economic_threshold_level: 1 larva per meter row or 1 moth/pheromone trap/day
damage_symptoms: Larva feeds on tender leaflets in vegetative stage, then defoliates flowers and bores into developing pods, eating developing seeds and reducing yield by up to 50%.

economic_threshold_level: 20-25% plants infested or 1.5 - 2.0 cm aphid colony on central shoot tip
damage_symptoms: Dense colonies of small greenish aphids suck sap from inflorescence, floral buds, and pods, curling flowers and resulting in pod shriveling and poor oil content.

economic_threshold_level: 1 larva per square meter or 2 larvae per plant at seedling stage
damage_symptoms: Greenish-black cylindrical larvae feed on leaves from edges towards midrib making large irregular holes, causing complete defoliation of young seedlings.

economic_threshold_level: 15% dead hearts during formative stage (up to 120 DAP)
damage_symptoms: Larva enters below ground level and tunnels upward, destroying central spindle and producing foul-smelling 'dead heart' that pulls out easily.

economic_threshold_level: 10% dead hearts or presence of red shot holes on leaf midribs
damage_symptoms: Shot holes on leaves, red tunnel along leaf midrib, destruction of growing tip resulting in bunchy top appearance with profuse lateral sprouting.

economic_threshold_level: 30 thrips per plant at vegetative / bulb initiation stage
damage_symptoms: Adults and nymphs congregate in leaf sheath axils, rasp epidermal tissues creating silvery white blotches and streaks. Leaves distort, dry from tip down, reducing bulb size.

economic_threshold_level: 5% leaf infestation in field or 2-4 moths/pheromone trap/week in store
damage_symptoms: In field, larvae mine leaves and tunnel through petioles into exposed tubers. In country stores, caterpillars bore winding tunnels through tubers filled with dark silken frass.

economic_threshold_level: 5% dead hearts or bore holes on pseudostems
damage_symptoms: Larvae bore into pseudostems and feed internally, resulting in yellowing and drying of central shoot ('dead heart'). Frass extrudes from boreholes.

economic_threshold_level: Presence of white circular scales on seed rhizomes before storage/planting
damage_symptoms: Circular greyish-white scales encrust rhizomes in storage and field, sucking sap, leading to shriveling, desiccation, and complete loss of germination.

economic_threshold_level: 5% silver shoots at tillering stage
damage_symptoms: Maggot feeds at growing tip of apical meristem, transforming leaf sheath into a hollow, tubular silvery-white gall called 'silver shoot' or 'onion leaf', preventing panicle formation.

economic_threshold_level: 1-2 bugs per hill or 5 bugs per sq. meter at milking stage
damage_symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck milky sap from developing grains during early morning and evening hours. Grains become empty, spotted brown, or chaffy, giving off an unpleasant buggy smell.

economic_threshold_level: 5 whiteflies per leaf or 5% webbed flowers/pods
damage_symptoms: Whiteflies transmit Mungbean Yellow Mosaic Virus; Maruca larvae web flowers and pods together, feeding internally on seeds.

economic_threshold_level: 20-25 nymphs/puparia per square inch on lower leaf surface
damage_symptoms: Nymphs suck sap from underside of leaves; leaves turn yellow and pinkish-purple, coated with black sooty mold; sucrose recovery drops by 1-2 units.
